name: Katherine Bonaldi
title: Psychologist
description: *Current availability* I am a trauma-sensitive Clinical Psychologist and Supervisor who has over 19 years experience working with adults with mental health concerns. In particular, trauma, complex trauma, anxiety, depression, life transitions and adjustment issues, OCD, chronic pain, illness and grief and loss. I also enjoy supporting health or helping professionals with work stress, burnout, vicarious trauma and compassion fatigue. I have worked in major public and private hospitals and private practices in Melbourne focusing on trauma, mood and chronic pain programs. I offer psychological assessments and tailored evidence-based therapies, in particular Schema therapy, Compassion focused therapy, Cognitive Processing Therapy, CBT, ERP, ACT, DBT and Mindfulness.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Emma Nicholls
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Emma Nicholls is a Clinical Psychologist and board-approved supervisor with over 18 years of experience. Emma’s therapeutic style is collaborative and warm, and she tailors treatment to focus on the client’s personal goals. Emma has extensive experience in working with trauma, PTSD, Complex PTSD, Personality Disorders, depression, anxiety disorders, relationship issues or breakdown, parenting, and recovering from family violence. Emma draws from CBT, DBT, ACT, CPT, Somatic Therapies, Schema Therapy, & trauma-focussed therapies.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy
